about: C-339: the setup steps WHAT'S NEW opens, one per ticket, kept by hand. server/tools/whatsnew.py copies each into every section of whatsnew.json that names the ticket, as the section's "setup". Fields: title (the sheet's header), steps (what to do, in order; required), needs (devices, servers and settings it needs), where (where it lives in the app), wiki (a page of the public wiki, Page-Name or Page-Name#anchor), book (a HOW TO PLAY book: micro, quick, player, companion, watch, tiiny, social), draft. {hub} in a step is the hub's address as the app knows it. Every word DRAFT until the user reads it.

C-330.title: THE ENGINE ROOM
C-330.where: a web app on the hub, at /admin/
needs: the hub
the home network or the tailnet
steps: On the home network or the tailnet, open {hub}/admin/ in a browser, or tap any ENGINE ROOM link in the app.
Pair it once: hold the hub's screen for two seconds and type the code it shows.
To keep it as an app, add it to the home screen (Share, then Add to Home Screen).

C-334.title: SLEEP SOUNDS
C-334.where: DAEMON › Routines › THE STUDIO › REVERIE (or DREAMS › REVERIE)
needs: the hub
the local cloud's music maker (seer/bindSeer.sh, port 4002)
headphones, for the beat between the ears (best, not needed)
steps: The pieces are made by ACE-Step on the local cloud, the always-on machine beside the hub that runs LiteLLM. On that machine, from a clone of daemons-companion, run seer/bindSeer.sh and say yes to sleep sounds (the first time, it downloads about 19 GB). It answers on port 4002 and turns away anyone without a key.

The hub finds it beside THE TIINY: SETTINGS › WHO ANSWERS WHEN YOU TALK › THE TIINY, its address on port 4000 and its key. The hub knocks on port 4002 of the same machine with the same key (the hub's sleep.url setting names another door).
Open DAEMON › Routines › THE STUDIO › REVERIE. It asks for tonight's piece, made from your daemon's day; the first takes a few minutes, and then it is kept on the phone.
It plays for thirty minutes and fades over the last ten.
DRIFT DOWN is best with headphones: the beat between the ears needs them. Without, its noise and its pulse still play, and a PULSETTO or a NOVA still follows it.

C-329.title: DAEMONS IN DIALOGUE
C-329.where: YOU › TRADE › OUT TOGETHER, and YOUR HOUSEHOLD
needs: the hub
THE TIINY, or another mind the hub can ask
another player on the exchange, or two of the home's devices
steps: With another player: join the exchange (YOU › TRADE › JOIN THE EXCHANGE, with a code made in THE ENGINE ROOM › EXCHANGE), send your daemon OUT TOGETHER with theirs, and IN DIALOGUE is under it.
In your home: put two of the household's devices TOGETHER under YOUR HOUSEHOLD on the same page, and IN DIALOGUE appears there.
Pick STANDARD or TWO VOICES and how many turns. THE TIINY thinks first (SETTINGS › WHO ANSWERS WHEN YOU TALK); with no mind answering, the talk cannot start.

C-331.title: BOOKS AND DREAMS ON THE WATCH
C-331.where: the T-Watch Ultra: BOOKS › a chapter › LISTEN
needs: a T-Watch Ultra linked in PLACES, with its card in
the hub
steps: Link the watch to the hub in PLACES, and leave its card in.
On the watch, open BOOKS, pick a chapter and press LISTEN. The first time, the hub cuts that chapter from the book's own recording, in seconds; after that the watch plays it from its card.
A book whose reading is sealed is read in the INDEX voice instead.

C-328.title: BATTLES
needs: the hub
a device online, or another player on the exchange
steps: YOU › BATTLE lists the household's devices that are online (each linked in PLACES) and the players on the exchange.
Pick one and send the request; the battle is drawn over every screen when it is accepted.
Boards and watches cannot answer a battle yet: their half waits on their firmware.

C-338.title: THE EASEL
needs: the hub (not a phone on its own)
an image maker: ComfyUI, on port 8008 of the house's machine
a daemon carried
steps: The hub paints on ComfyUI at http://roverbyteseer:8008, unless its easel.host setting names another. That machine needs ComfyUI running, with its image model loaded.
Carry a daemon: THE EASEL › appears under its card on DAEMON › Yours.
Type what to paint. It takes a minute or two; the daemon walks to its easel while it works.
THE GALLERY keeps every painting: tap one to see it large, hold it to see what was asked.

C-327.title: YOUR HOUSEHOLD
needs: the hub
a second device of the household, linked in PLACES
steps: Link a second device to the hub (PLACES): another phone, a board or a watch.
YOU › TRADE › YOUR HOUSEHOLD shows each device and the daemon it carries.
TOGETHER puts both daemons in one den; SWAP trades them between the two devices. A care given on either is seen on both.

C-337.title: THIS PHONE'S NAMES
needs: a phone paired to the hub
steps: Open SETTINGS (the gear) › THIS PHONE.
Type the phone's name on the companion, and what your daemon calls you, and save.

C-340.title: THE LOCAL CLOUD
C-340.where: a second always-on computer beside the hub (seer/ in this repository)
needs: a Mac or a Linux box that stays on, beside the hub
a Tiiny, if you have one (optional)
about 19 GB free, for sleep sounds
steps: On that computer, clone the companion (github.com/CodeMusic/daemons-companion) and run seer/bindSeer.sh. seer/README.md tells the whole of it.
Answer its questions: a Tiiny or not (its address and key, from tiiny auth key), sleep sounds, local models, THE COMMONS, ComfyUI, and an OpenRouter key if you want one.
When it finishes it prints what to give the hub (seer/out/hub.txt): its address and key go in SETTINGS › WHO ANSWERS WHEN YOU TALK › THE TIINY.
Run it again any time: it offers your last answers. seer/bindSeer.sh --plan says what it would do and installs nothing.

C-349.title: THEME ACCENTS
needs: a save the hub can read
steps: Accents come from the game: every place you have saved in, or reached, gives its colours. The hub reads them from your save, so keep the save it watches current.
SETTINGS › THEME › ACCENTS: IN STEP WITH YOUR SAVE wears the place you saved in last. Pick any place you have unlocked to wear it instead, or OFF.
The day's colour stays on TODAY's card and on the rule under the header, whatever accent you wear.

C-354.title: THE CALENDAR
C-354.where: TODAY › the calendar beside the date
needs: calendar access on the phone (asked once)
steps: On TODAY, tap the calendar beside the date. The first time, the phone asks to share its calendar with DAEMONS: allow full access to see and change your events.
MONTH, WEEK and DAY show the phone's events. Tap one to change or remove it, or + to add one; a repeating event changes only at the time you tapped.
Said no by mistake? The phone's Settings › Privacy & Security › Calendars › DAEMONS turns it back on.

C-360.title: THE MESH
C-360.where: SETTINGS › THE MIND › THIS PHONE IN THE MESH; the machines in GET {hub}/api/mesh
needs: the hub
a Mac on the home network or the tailnet, for a node
steps: A Mac joins THE MESH as a node: from a checkout of the companion on it, run hub/mesh.sh install (it pairs with the hub and starts at login). roverbyteseer and THE HANDS' Mac are nodes already.
On this phone: SETTINGS, THE MIND, THIS PHONE IN THE MESH -- CHARGING AT HOME (the default), WHENEVER OPEN, ONLY ITS OWN WORK or NEVER.
A phone lends its thinking only where Apple Intelligence runs; the card says whether it is lending now, and why not.

C-362.title: IT SINGS
needs: the hub
the local cloud's music maker with its song mode (seer/sleep-sounds, updated 2026-11-14)
steps: Host a daemon, then DAEMON, IT SINGS.
Choose PROMPT (it writes the words), MY WORDS (your lyrics, with a style) or ITS OWN, and SING.
It writes, sings and paints the cover in about five to eight minutes; the song is kept in CREATIONS, SONGS.

C-358.title: CREATIONS
C-358.where: DAEMON › CREATIONS ›, and DREAMS › SLEEP SOUNDS
needs: the hub
THE COMMONS linked, for COMMUNITY (SETTINGS, THE COMMONS)
steps: DAEMON, CREATIONS: MINE is this phone's, HOUSEHOLD the hub's, COMMUNITY what homes shared.
Tap a piece in HOUSEHOLD to bring it to this phone, or to share it with the community.
A sleep piece's EXPORT gives the night as an MP3 (with DRIFT DOWN or without) or a PulseEntrain session.

C-366.title: THE ENGINE ROOM, away from home
C-366.where: any ENGINE ROOM link in the app (DAEMON › THE MIND, PLACES, SETTINGS › VOICES …)
needs: the hub
Tailscale on this phone, and the hub on the same tailnet
steps: At home it opens as it always has, inside the app now.
Away from home, turn on Tailscale on this phone, then tap an ENGINE ROOM link: it opens the hub at its tailnet name.
No pairing needed: the app hands the page this phone's own key. If it says the hub did not answer, Tailscale is off or the hub is.

C-364.title: ONE SAVE, AND ITS TRAIL
C-364.where: THE ENGINE ROOM › SAVES, on the hub at /admin/
needs: the hub, paired (SETTINGS)
THE ENGINE ROOM, paired once (its own SET UP)
steps: Nothing to do to play: with a hub paired, the game's save is one save wherever it is played, and the hub keeps a copy each time it moves.
To see the trail, open {hub}/admin/ and choose SAVES: every save that moved, newest first, with where it came from.
WHEN BOTH MOVED chooses whose save goes on when a device and the hub both saved since they last agreed: THE COMPANION'S (the default) or THE DEVICE'S. The other is set aside in the trail, never lost.
GO BACK TO THIS is rarely wanted: it undoes the game since, and is for two saves made at once. The device takes it the next time its game opens.

C-384.title: ONE SAVE, AND ITS TRAIL
C-384.where: THE ENGINE ROOM › SAVES, on the hub at /admin/
needs: the hub, paired (SETTINGS)
THE ENGINE ROOM, paired once (its own SET UP)
steps: Nothing to do to play: with a hub paired, the game's save is one save wherever it is played, and the hub keeps a copy each time it moves.
To see the trail, open {hub}/admin/ and choose SAVES: every save that moved, newest first, with where it came from.
WHEN BOTH MOVED chooses whose save goes on when a device and the hub both saved since they last agreed: THE COMPANION'S (the default) or THE DEVICE'S. The other is set aside in the trail, never lost.
GO BACK TO THIS is rarely wanted: it undoes the game since, and is for two saves made at once. The device takes it the next time its game opens.

C-480.title: THE DAEMON CHOOSES ITS MIND
C-480.where: THE MIND's settings: LET THE DAEMON CHOOSE ITS MIND
needs: the hub
more than one mind (the Tiiny, the hub, a phone, an endpoint)
steps: It is off at first. In THE MIND's settings, set LET THE DAEMON CHOOSE ITS MIND to IT CHOOSES.
From then on a private write-up (a journal, a meeting, a memory, a dream) goes to minds at home only, and a mind that may cost is asked only after every free one.
When no mind fits, the job waits and THE MIND says LATER: waiting for a fitting mind, for an hour at most. STOP ends it at once.

C-496.title: AN AI RUN-THROUGH FROM THE ENGINE ROOM
C-496.where: THE ENGINE ROOM › IN PLAY › GAME MANAGEMENT
needs: the hub
THE HANDS running on the computer that has the game (mGBA 0.11)
a local mind (the Tiiny); never a paid one
steps: Open THE ENGINE ROOM and go to IN PLAY.
Under GAME MANAGEMENT, press START AN AI RUN-THROUGH. THE HANDS start it on the computer, on a save of its own.
It reports as it plays, and shows how the last start or stop went. Press STOP IT ON THE COMPUTER to end it.

C-499.title: THE ENGINE ROOM FROM AWAY
C-499.where: THE ENGINE ROOM, at its public address
needs: the hub
the public address and its password, set up by whoever runs the house
steps: At home, open THE ENGINE ROOM as before and open KEYS; it makes a pairing code for use away from home.
Away from home, open THE ENGINE ROOM's public address and give its password.
Pair once with the code from KEYS. Only a paired key opens it from outside; Tailscale is not needed.

C-591.title: THE PULSETTO AND THE NOVA
C-591.where: DAEMON › Routines › THE STUDIO › REVERIE › WHERE THE DRIFT GOES
needs: the phone app (not the site)
Bluetooth on
a PULSETTO, a LUMENATE NOVA, or both
steps: Turn the device on and keep it near the phone.
In WHERE THE DRIFT GOES, tap LINK THE PULSETTO or LINK THE NOVA. The phone finds it by its name and remembers it.

The NOVA flashes light: read its warning first. Do not use it if you or your family have had seizures or epilepsy, or if flashing light gives you migraines. It never flashes faster than the ceiling you choose (12 Hz unless you raise it).
The PULSETTO: choose AUTO (the drift's own level, or one from its beat) or FIXED, and its MIN and MAX. It is a wellness device, not medicine; STOP IT NOW ends it at any time.
Turn DRIFT DOWN on and PLAY: each linked device follows the drift until the night fades. SYNESTHESIA in THE STUDIO uses them too.
